calm.instructions: Subdued patient voice. Speaking to a doctor in clinic. Slightly tired, low energy. Cooperative but not chatty. Moderate-low volume, slightly slow pace.
calm.text: 嗯，医生您问吧，我尽量配合您。

pleased.instructions: Light, pleasant tone. Warm and engaged. Slightly faster pace. Smiling voice. Natural upward inflection.
pleased.text: 谢谢您啊医生，您问得真仔细，我心里踏实多了。

irritated.instructions: Cold tone. Short clipped answers. Slight edge in voice. Normal volume but sharp.
irritated.text: 行吧，你问快点，我还有事呢。

angry.instructions: LOUD. High sharp pitch. Very fast aggressive delivery. Each word spat out forcefully. Confrontational tone like an argument. Hard attack on consonants.
angry.text: 你到底会不会看病？问来问去的烦不烦！

furious.instructions: EXTREMELY LOUD. SHOUTING. Voice hoarse and straining. Maximum speed. Words explode out like gunfire. Growling snarling tone.
furious.text: 我不跟你说！换医生！把你主任叫来！！

uneasy.instructions: Hesitant delivery. Volume rises and falls unpredictably. Words drawn out then rushed. Uncertainty in every syllable.
uneasy.text: 医生……应该没什么大事吧？我有点害怕。

fearful.instructions: Voice trembling slightly. Lowered volume. Speaking in broken phrases with pauses. Pitch unsteady.
fearful.text: 这、这到底严不严重啊？会不会出大问题？

terrified.instructions: Voice shaking violently like shivering. Very quiet, barely audible. Fragmented speech, cannot finish sentences. Barely a whisper.
terrified.text: 我……我真的不行了……救救我……

down.instructions: Low pitch, very slow pace, monotone. Voice heavy and dragging. Words slurred slightly from exhaustion.
down.text: 唉……反正就这样吧，我这身体是越来越差了。

sad.instructions: Low slow delivery. Pitch drops heavily at end of each phrase. Voice thick with held-back tears. Pauses mid-sentence.
sad.text: 医生，我真的很难受……有时候话都不想说。

broken.instructions: CRYING HARD while speaking. Voice shattered by sobs. Heavy nasal congestion. Each word interrupted by crying. Pitch wavering wildly.
broken.text: 呜呜……我真的撑不下去了……每天都像在熬日子……

wariness.instructions: Guarded but cooperative. Cool, reserved tone. Short clipped answers. Distant and watchful. Undercurrent of suspicion.
wariness.text: 你先说你是哪个科的？之前那个医生也是这么问的。
